numbering.scheme: 4-digit numeric account_code, one block per account_type: 1000-1999 asset, 2000-2999 liability, 3000-3999 equity, 4000-4999 income, 5000-5999 cost of sales (account_type remains 'expense' - a numbering-only distinction, since the account_type CHECK admits only asset|liability|equity|income|expense), 6000-6999 operating expense, 9000-9999 system roles. No dash or slash sub-account suffix; sub-account granularity is reached by spacing plain codes within a block.
numbering.rationale: Research-earned, not habit. Of the 8 software products with confirmed numbering evidence, 3 (Bukku - the one genuinely cloud-native Malaysian SaaS surveyed and Clara's closest product analog; Sage UBS; NCL) converge on this exact 4-digit block shape, and QuickBooks Online's own suggested ranges (once account numbers are enabled) follow the identical convention. It is also the universal GAAP teaching convention. It satisfies the FIRST branch of the already-shipped ck_coa_account_code_0009 CHECK (^[0-9]{4,8}$) with no dash-parsing needed. Explicitly REJECTED: the 3-digit-dash convention (XXX-0000 / XXX-000) used by the three highest-installed-base desktop incumbents (AutoCount, SQL Account, QNE) - that shape is structurally identical to ROME PROPERTIES' carried-down '300-000' chart (300-000 TRADE DEBTORS, 400-000 TRADE CREDITORS), which the owner's ruling explicitly names as one of the two forms not to pick (coa-template-gate-record.md Q2 folded against rulings-0829-sitting.md: neither the estate seed's 4-digit habit nor RPR's carried-down 300-000 style). Full evidence table: coa-template-research-2026-08-29.md SS2.

families.label: Leave Passage (Tax-Split)

families.label: Private and Proprietor's Expenses (Tax-Split)

families.label: Club Subscriptions and Entrance Fees (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.39(1)(m) - standalone disallowance, distinct from the entertainment 50% rule - no dedicated Public Ruling

families.label: Doubtful Debts and Unapproved Provisions (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.34(2); PR 4/2019 (replaces PR 1/2002) - a specific provision is deductible, a general provision is not; s.39(1)(c) for unapproved pension/provident fund contributions

families.label: Equity - Company
families.basis: Companies Act 2016 s.74 (no-par-value regime, effective 2017-01-31); MPERS 4.11(f)/4.12

families.label: Equity - Sole Proprietorship
families.basis: firm practice per professional convention (ACCA FA2; IFRS for SMEs Module 4 worked examples) - no capital/current split for a sole proprietor, capital and drawings only. Hard constraint 13: a sole proprietor's own account is EQUITY, never a staff advance.

families.label: Equity - Partnership
families.basis: firm practice per professional convention (ACCA FA2; IFRS for SMEs Module 4 S4.13) - capital and current accounts per partner; profit-sharing ratio governed by the Partnership Act 1961, not an accounting standard
